thread:
Maya: kicking off eu-central-2 GPU cluster bring-up (pilot). sharing the minimal smoke checklist + quick cost scenarios. tagging infra/net/capacity. :rocket:

Jin: on network checks. I’ve already reserved the three /28 public IPs for NAT. need to confirm AZ spread for edge proxies. any region-specific constraints?

Rachel: capacity note — K80/older GPUs not available in this region. target pool = 8 x a100-sim nodes to start. will prepare autoscale policy for burst to 16 if warm pool healthy.

Maya: good. primary goals: 1) boot cluster 2) verify node health & nvlink 3) run inference-smoke to validate kernels 4) validate routing & egress under load 5) produce cost delta vs sfo1 baseline.

Tom: deploy-bot kicked the bootstrap earlier, saw a couple transient kubelet restarts on first attempt. log snip below:
```
May 12 03:12:11 node-03 kubelet[9123]: E05012 03:12:11.123 kubelet.go:234] failed to reconcile pod... imagepullbackoff
May 12 03:12:14 node-03 systemd[1]: Started NVIDIA Persistence Daemon.
May 12 03:12:18 node-03 nvidia-smi: Driver loaded, 0 processes
```

Maya: thanks — looks like an image registry flap. Jin, confirm registry route and ttl.

Jin: registry route had a bad route53 TTL (30s) during bootstrap, increased to 300s. re-pulled images on node-03, node is now Ready.

deploy-bot: cluster-provision job #eu-cent-2-boot started at 2128000012. status: in_progress :gear:

Maya: smoke test commands (run from ops jumpbox):
```bash
# node & driver checks
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl describe node node-01 | egrep -i "nvidia|gpu|allocatable"
nvidia-smi -L
# simple perf run (short)
rdwctl run-inference --model redwood-lite --batch 4 --tokens 512 --duration 60s --region eu-central-2
```

Rachel: ran the inference-smoke with 8 concurrent threads for 1m. p50=38ms, p95=142ms, error rate 0.8%. GPU util peaked 86%. no OOMs.

Maya: SLO gate proposals for bring-up (pass/fail):
- Node provisioning time: Median < 4m, 95th < 10m
- NVLink and driver present: yes/no per node
- Kernel/quant path successful for redwood-lite: <2% inference errors
- Network egress: 99.9% success for 1k parallel fetches to model repo
- Cost flag: baseline incremental monthly = +35% vs sfo1 for identical pool size.

Tom: noted. on the cost delta, spot availability in eu-central-2 is low => heavy reliance on on-demand increases run rate. I’ll attach a quick scenario:
- baseline 8 nodes on-demand: $X/month
- mixed: 6 on-demand + 2 spot: ~ +20% vs sfo1
- all on-demand during initial ramp (recommended): +35% (conservative)

Maya: add operational mitigations: pre-warm a warm-pool of 2 nodes, enable burst autoscale but cap burst to 12 until 72h of stable telemetry.

Jin: network sanity checks done:
- BGP routes validated to two edge peers
- NAT gateways in each AZ healthy
- egress band throttle set to 800Mbps by default for pilot
- iptables config pushed, no asymmetric routing detected

Maya: run the extended health script and share output snippet. also run KV-cache warmup for models to exercise memory paths.

Rachel: extended health run results (short):
- driver: green
- nvlink: green
- temps: 48C-67C under smoke
- kernel compile path: pass
- small memory leak observed on node-06 native lib at ~2MB/min — scheduled restart window in 30m

Tom: flagged node-06 for restart in maintenance window (30m). deploying canary patch to drop the offending lib load.

Maya: handoff checklist before marking ready_for_handoff:
1) all nodes Ready and no OOMs in last 60m
2) smoke run p95 < 160ms and error rate <1%
3) network egress success >= 99.9%
4) cost scenario documented and POA for burst pricing
5) oncall runbook updated with node-swap playbook and vendor contact

Rachel: current status: nodes Ready=8/8 (node-06 draining then back), smoke p95=150ms, error=0.9%, egress=99.95%, cost doc uploaded to drive: https://drive.company/internal/euc2-costs (ops only).

Maya: thumbs up. can someone from oncall own the 72h watch and daily telemetry check?

Tom: I can take first 24h, then hand to oncall rotation.

Jin: network + registry oncall handoff to @net-oncall done.\n
deploy-bot: cluster-provision job #eu-cent-2-boot updated: status: healthy, tests_passed=smoke, uptime=00:12:34 :white_check_mark:

Maya: ok — marking this thread as "ready_for_handoff". filing a brief runbook PR for the specifics (warm-pool config, autoscale caps, node restart incident notes). please add any missed items. :wave:
